messages.subject: GridExtra, ggplot2 and ggthemes
parts:
Dear All,
My problem is that I need to combine some radar facet plots with a
global note and the recent changes in gridExtra and ggplot2 are giving
me a headache.
Please consider for a start the following snippet

#########################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

#this works with the development version of ggplot2 and gridExtra.
#(you need the development
#version of ggplot2 because it
#does not complain about g not
#being a ggplot2 object).
# see also
#http://bit.ly/1O00Syf


toyota <- mpg[which(mpg$manufacturer == 'toyota'), ]
p <- ggplot(toyota, aes(displ, hwy)) + facet_wrap(~ class, ncol = 2) +
geom_point(aes(size=cyl))
## print(p)



g <- arrangeGrob(p, sub = textGrob("Footnote", x = 0,
hjust = -0.1, vjust=0.1, gp = gpar(fontface = "italic", fontsize =
18)))

## t <- textGrob("text")

## g <- arrangeGrob(p,)

ggsave("plot_grid_extra.png", g)
##############################################
Taken from

http://bit.ly/1O00Syf

The script above does not work unless I use the development version of
ggplot2, because the stable ggplot2 release will complain about g not
being a ggplot2 object, as pointed out in the gridExtra wiki and mentioned here


http://bit.ly/1Ktr6cW

The solution is to install the development version of ggplot2 in order
to be able to handle the footnote.
However, the development version of ggplot2 does not seem to
understand how to produce radar plots

For instance, in the snippet at the end of the email, taken from

http://bit.ly/1JDBCdX

ggplot2 now outputs

Error: Don't know how to add coord_radar() to a plot (whereas the same
script runs on my machine with the stable ggplot2).
Does anybody know how to fix this?
Essentially I need to reconcile the development version of ggplot2
with the radar geometry.
Any suggestion is appreciated.
Cheers

Lorenzo

###################################################
coord_radar <- function(...) {
structure(coord_polar(...), class = c("radar", "polar", "coord"))
}
is.linear.radar <- function(coord) TRUE

library("ggplot2")


mtcarsscaled <- as.data.frame(lapply(mtcars, ggplot2:::rescale01))
mtcarsscaled$model <- rownames(mtcars)
mtcarsmelted <- reshape2::melt(mtcarsscaled)

ggplot(mtcarsmelted, aes(x = variable, y = value)) +
geom_polygon(aes(group = model, color = model), fill = NA, size = 2)
+
facet_wrap(~ model) +
theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
axis.text.x = element_blank(),
axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
axis.text.y = element_blank()) +
xlab("") + ylab("") +
guides(color = "none") +
coord_radar()
